def transform(grid):
    """Align the two panels and mark positions where their shared color coincides."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find a full separator row or column.
    cutrow = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1), None)
    if cutrow is not None:
        a, b = grid[:cutrow], grid[cutrow+1:]
        if len(a) != len(b):
            raise ValueError('unequal panel heights')
        shared = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
        if len(shared) != 1:
            raise ValueError('expected one shared panel color')
        color = next(iter(shared))
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color
                 for c in range(w)] for r in range(len(a))]
    cutcol = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    if cutcol is None:
        raise ValueError('divider not found')
    a = [row[:cutcol] for row in grid]
    b = [row[cutcol+1:] for row in grid]
    if any(len(x) != len(y) for x, y in zip(a, b)):
        raise ValueError('unequal panel widths')
    shared = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
    if len(shared) != 1:
        raise ValueError('expected one shared panel color')
    color = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(len(a[r]))] for r in range(h)]
